#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using lli = long long;

lli comb[40][40];

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    // Precompute Pascal's triangle
    for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 40; j++) {
            if (j > i) comb[i][j] = 0;
            else if (j == 0 || j == i) comb[i][j] = 1;
            else comb[i][j] = comb[i-1][j-1] + comb[i-1][j];
        }
    }

    lli R, C;
    cin >> R >> C;
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    lli n = R + C;

    // dp[x][y] = map of (score difference) -> count
    // x = number of A's used, y = number of B's used
    vector<map<lli, lli>> dp((n+1)*(n+1));
    vector<map<lli, lli>> bp((n+1)*(n+1));
    
    auto idx = [&](lli x, lli y) { return x*(n+1) + y; };
    
    dp[idx(0,0)][0] = 1;
    
    lli total = comb[2*R+2*C][2*R];
    
    for (lli x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
        for (lli y = 0; y <= n; y++) {
            if (x == 0 && y == 0) continue;
            
            lli pos = x + y - 1;
            if (pos >= (lli)s.size()) continue;
            
            // Calculate contribution for position pos
            lli contrib = 0;
            if (pos < 2*R) {
                contrib = 1;
            }
            
            // From dp[x-1][y] (adding A)
            if (x > 0) {
                if (s[pos] != 'B') {
                    for (auto &p : dp[idx(x-1,y)]) {
                        lli new_diff = p.first + contrib;
                        dp[idx(x,y)][new_diff] += p.second;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // From dp[x][y-1] (adding B)
            if (y > 0) {
                if (s[pos] != 'A') {
                    for (auto &p : dp[idx(x,y-1)]) {
                        lli new_diff = p.first - contrib;
                        dp[idx(x,y)][new_diff] += p.second;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Count valid orderings with minimum unfairness
    lli min_unfairness = LLONG_MAX;
    for (auto &p : dp[idx(n,n)]) {
        lli unfair = abs(p.first);
        if (unfair < min_unfairness) min_unfairness = unfair;
    }
    
    lli result = 0;
    for (auto &p : dp[idx(n,n)]) {
        if (abs(p.first) == min_unfairness) {
            result += p.second;
        }
    }
    
    cout << result << '\n';
    return 0;
}
